title: Welcome to Summer Camp 2026!
body: This hub is your home base for the whole summer — check it each morning to see what we're building and learning that day.

title: First day is Monday, June 29
body: Camp runs Monday through Thursday. Bring a water bottle and your curiosity — we start with the SPIKE Prime kit on day one!

title: Coach prep checklist
body: Charge all SPIKE Prime hubs, verify the build instruction stations, add camper accounts in the Students tab, and fill in the open days for Weeks 7-8 in the schedule editor.
